definitions.gloss: thorough enjoyment; relishing to the full
definitions.explanation: The act of enjoying something fully and to one's complete satisfaction, savoring every aspect of an experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{満喫|まんきつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I thoroughly enjoyed my day off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{満喫|まんきつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦リフレッシュ→リフレッシュ：11261_rifuresshu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I refreshed myself by fully enjoying the hot springs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行先|りょこうさき}→旅行先：28195_ryokousaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{満喫|まんきつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I was able to relish the local cuisine at my travel destination.

notes:
A ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ noun meaning to enjoy something to the fullest extent. Composed of {満|まん} (full) and {喫|きつ} (to receive, to consume). Conveys deep, complete satisfaction rather than casual enjoyment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{満喫|まんきつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to fully enjoy a holiday
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{満喫|まんきつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to savor nature
- ⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{満喫|まんきつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to relish a trip
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{満喫|まんきつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to enjoy life to the fullest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧ — to enjoy; more general and everyday, while {満喫|まんきつ} emphasizes completeness and deep satisfaction
- ⟦{堪能|たんのう}→堪能：12081_tannou⟧ — to enjoy fully; very close in meaning but ⟦{堪能|たんのう}→堪能：12081_tannou⟧ also means "proficient" and has a slightly more literary feel
